entities.name: Krzysztof Głowacki
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Krzysztof Głowacki is a Polish professional mixed martial artist and professional boxer. As a boxer he held the WBO junior-heavyweight title twice; from 2015 to 2016 and again in 2019. As an amateur, he won a bronze medal in the super-heavyweight division at the 2008 EU Championships.
